requirements.acceptance_rule: all declared source artifacts exist and match immutable SHA-256 values
requirements.text: Qualification evidence shall fail closed on missing, changed, or stale artifacts.

requirements.acceptance_rule: every requirement and claim resolves through at least one trace link
requirements.text: Requirements, claims, evidence, tests, and limitations shall be bidirectionally traceable.

requirements.acceptance_rule: Phase 3 v7 overall_pass is true and v5/v6 failure evidence remains separately hash-bound
requirements.text: The frozen synthetic characterization shall remain reproducible without rewriting historical failures.

requirements.acceptance_rule: all physical evidence counts equal zero and recorded/HIL verdict is UNAVAILABLE_DEFERRED
requirements.text: Synthetic/software evidence shall never satisfy a recorded, HIL, field, or physical claim.
No production-RF qualification claim is allowed without independent physical evidence.
